milestone: Alpha 1.73 exact escrow producer, owned delivery and offer save barrier
status: prepared primitives; ordinary trade handlers and recovery admission not connected
changes: Plan offered items, Gold debit and private escrow together under ordered actor/world ownership. Reject inconsistent escrow, ambiguous custody across bag/stash/buyback/equipment, unsupported state, oversized payloads, invalid stacks and revision overflow before mutation. Identical offer retries retain revision and confirmations.

Persist the other participant's stable account/player/character binding in every produced escrow, so an orphan offer does not depend on the lost RAM table to identify its peer. Refuse a mismatched peer, unavailable player, distant/different scene or casino seating.

Fingerprint account-bound participant plans independently of array order, preserving each account's own offer/revision. Either player can reconstruct the same economic cancellation after restart without redefining the first frozen decision.

Apply an exact participant decision into owned private delivery plus receipt without changing visible bag or Gold. Claim the whole delivery on detached storage, preserving affixes, Forge basis and gems; only exact metadata can stack. Full bags, partial-fit failures, wallet limits, duplicate custody and future unsupported item fields retain the original outbox without world loot or sender compensation.

A prepared server offer-save primitive reconciles previous saves, produces the escrow/debit post-image, and confirms the existing character journal/committer before returning success. Unknown commit results retain the journal; real local write failure pins the only actor copy against expiry. No ordinary message handler uses this primitive yet.

Legacy RAM edit, confirm, cancel and disconnect-refund paths fail closed for either participant's private state. Remove an ephemeral table without financial effects only with a trusted complete shared decision. These guards are not a replacement for the coordinator integration.

checks.game: Actual world APIs cover exact offer/debit ownership, repeated edits, full-bag swap/rejected return, nine invalid private/custody cases, all legacy fallback guards including the unoffered peer, gift recipients, settlement/cancellation with reversed participant order, repeated post-claim decisions/claims, seven all-or-none delivery failures, exact versus mismatched stack metadata, peer rebinding and five unavailable-peer cases.
checks.journal: Actual character snapshot and BSON filesystem journal cover confirmed/repeated offer saves; database rejection and committed-but-lost acknowledgement drop all live offers/entities and reopen the journal. The injected atomic-receipt model preserves later Gold credit on lost-ACK replay. Missing journal/committer, prior pending save and wrong account binding deny new mutation. A renamed journal directory produces real IO failure; actual disconnected expiry retains the only escrow copy and later reconciliation persists it.
checks.fixtureCorrections: Initial game fixtures lacked health required for ordinary pickup and compared a live nil slice against an owned empty-slice snapshot. Corrected live-player setup and consistent table copies. The internal expiry pin intentionally is not in detached entity copies; test the actual expiry operation instead. Corrected a nonexistent CasinoSeat test type to CasinoSeatSession. No resource, save or fail-closed assertion was weakened.
checks.format: gofmt and git diff --check passed. No broad unchanged campaign, soak, database launch or native-browser rerun.

limits: No live protocol, actual Mongo execution, assembled fresh-process socket, native-browser, push or deployment acceptance. Store index/repository tests remain for isolated CI. The accepted live baseline remains Alpha1.70.1 fa414f0b288e8ee014d5ce72f7affdca485e1c7f.

Still required: both-account message/cleanup/recovery work-lock ownership, frozen-intent confirmation/cancellation, online/offline apply-and-save coordination, durable completion, startup/login orphan and pending-intent recovery, admission fencing and owned-delivery feedback/retry integration. Current ordinary handlers remain RAM-based for characters without private state.

The game-layer test supplies a complete record only to exercise nonfinancial table retirement; it does not simulate proving both database receipts. The production coordinator must obtain that complete record from the durable store.

Earlier prepared model fixtures without a peer remain readable, but orphan recovery must fail closed rather than guess one. Every runtime-produced escrow now supplies the full peer binding. No such escrow has been produced in production.

Writer schema18 still fences older readers; opaque byte retention is not an unrestricted rollback/recovery strategy. Valuable-operation ledger, final integrated gates and ordered version/notes/publication remain open. No complete1.73 or whole-economy crash-safety claim.
